method: Direct composable checks using real Vue refs, isolated/stubbed upload responses and metadata fixtures
boundary: Local implementation checks; not full browser or live-backend acceptance

checks.description: Initialization preserves product URLs/legacy empty strings and explicitly clears with null
Cancelled selection leaves cover, error and idle state unchanged
Unsupported MIME is rejected without upload or replacement and input is reset
One byte above the 5 MiB boundary is rejected before calling upload
Exactly 5 MiB passes client screening (upload response stubbed, not backend image acceptance)
JPEG, PNG and WebP replace a single cover and share only the photo-error field
Upload failure retains old cover and allows successful retry of the same file
In-flight upload blocks picker, removal and a second file-change request
Submitting state blocks cover upload, picker and removal
Idle picker/removal work and a missing DOM input is handled safely
